name: 86 Chaos 18.0.3
label: 86 Chaos 18.0.3
notes: Mobile branch only; targeted tests only.
No full Release Gate or full Play Store suite is run.
Fixes stale Android/iOS 18.0.1 regex expectations in the targeted test.
No new paid service or Firebase project is introduced.
title: 86 Chaos 18.0.3
summary: Makes native API bridge tests patch-safe so future 18.0.x version bumps validate the actual current native identities.
description: No functional product change beyond release identity. The targeted test now derives Android and iOS expectations from the current package and native contract instead of stale patch literals.
highlights: Packaged native app no longer sends /api requests to the phone-local asset server.
CapacitorHttp carries authenticated API calls to https://testing.86chaos.com while Firebase stays on the testing project.
Android and iOS native versions are aligned to 18.0.1 / build 180001.
Targeted Android Chromium and iPhone WebKit coverage includes the packaged API bridge contract.
